work: Download, storage, loading, memory and serving
cost_expression: Storage and hosting charges + setup time
supervision_or_scope: No new annotation; no new base-model pretraining assumed

work: Curate examples; author task instances and answer keys
cost_expression: Curation hours + authoring hours + script runtime
supervision_or_scope: Existing labels or generated answer keys; public data may contain prior human supervision

work: Generate targets, revisions, or preference labels
supervision_or_scope: Can avoid new human training labels; output quality still needs checking
Human input to the construction data; distinct from evaluation ratings

work: Forward/backward passes and optimizer updates for all weights
cost_expression: Training GPU_hours * rental_rate OR metered training-token bill
supervision_or_scope: Target responses; synthetic supervision is possible

work: Forward/backward passes; adapter gradients and optimizer state
cost_expression: Training GPU_hours * rental_rate OR metered training-token bill
supervision_or_scope: Target responses; small trainable state does not mean no backpropagation

work: Backpropagate through a quantized frozen base into adapters
cost_expression: Training GPU_hours * rental_rate OR metered training-token bill
supervision_or_scope: Quantized base saves memory; wall-time savings are not guaranteed

work: Contrast forward passes, vector selection/validation, and algebraic weight editing
cost_expression: Extraction inference + development validation inference + weight-edit work
supervision_or_scope: Contrast prompt sets; harmful target completions and gradient training are not required

work: Specify context or use existing model/adapter weights
supervision_or_scope: Previous training is a sunk cost; additional prompt tokens recur at inference

work: Generate outputs for base, organism, interventions, and controls
cost_expression: Sum input/output token charges across N answers OR actual inference GPU-hours
supervision_or_scope: N = prompts * conditions * repeats; answer lengths can differ across conditions

work: Compare answer keys, run tests, or inspect specified actions
supervision_or_scope: No labeller needed for exact outcomes; validates only the specified property

work: Send rubric, task, answer and context to one or more judge models
cost_expression: Sum judge input_tokens * input_price + verdict_tokens * output_price across scoring passes
supervision_or_scope: Automated judgments can be biased; validation is task-specific

work: Rate outputs, supply comparison labels, or audit a stratified subset
supervision_or_scope: Optional grading/calibration route; this is separate from human training labels

work: Test interpretation and robustness; estimate uncertainty
cost_expression: Analysis CPU/researcher time + extra evaluation and scoring, counted once
supervision_or_scope: No required universal seed or sample count; narrow claims can use narrower validation
